audit.whatIsWrong: This is the worst chart in the slice and the packet says so itself: 'level chart contradicts data: Mordekaiser wins only 44.09% but the chart gives Mordekaiser 4/7 stages vs 0'. The live page is worse than the packet — it gives Mordekaiser 5/7 and Zaahen ZERO rows in a matchup he loses 56% of the time. Every field on the page reads as a won lane: diff 'EVEN', difficulty 6/10, and a late paragraph that says 'your isolation duel beats his bruiser kit outright'.
audit.why: 44.09% over 1794 games is not an even lane, and a chart in which the enemy never wins a single stage cannot produce that number. Because the packet's OWN chart is flagged as contradicting the data, I did not simply copy it — I kept its rows 0-4 (which are plausible: Mordekaiser's window is the level 3-5 Darkness Rise stretch) and moved the two item rows to Zaahen, which is where the losing win rate has to come from and which the kit supports directly.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen as one atomic paired group. Also raised diffRating to 8/10 with matching breakdown.difficulty, breakdown.carry and report[14].t so the page stops describing a losing lane as even.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4'. The three present are Lvl 3, 1st item and 2+ items — and ALL THREE are Mordekaiser spikes. There is no entry anywhere in the array for a Zaahen power spike, which is a large part of why the page reads as a free lane.

audit.corrected: Created spikes[3] with "before": null, filled with Zaahen's real late spike from his own kit: Determination filling into bonus Attack Damage and a revive, plus the Q and R heals. Nothing invented — every element is in Riot's ability text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer does not name or describe a single Zaahen ability. It refers to 'Ultimate' as though that were the ability's name, in fourteen separate fields, and breakdown.cooldowns ships an internal TODO to the customer: 'Zaahen Ultimate (verify): His power spike — verify the exact name + effect on the live patch.' Meanwhile the enemyKit in this brief has complete text and cooldowns for all five slots, and none of it reached the page: the passive REVIVES him, Q heals and is an auto-attack reset whose recast knocks up, W is an 850-range pull, E is a dash whose damage scales with the target's health, and R heals him for a portion of the damage dealt.
audit.why: A page that says 'verify this yourself' is worse than no page. And the revive is decisive here specifically: Mordekaiser's entire gameplan is a Realm of Death 1v1 kill, and this champion can stand back up from it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the 'Ultimate' placeholder framing with the real mechanics throughout tldr, winCon, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d, using real cooldowns (R 110s/80s, W 14s at 850 range, E 8s at rank 5). Filled the three empty dontsFull bodies with the auto-reset tell, the Determination/revive spike, and the percent-health dash. Added anti-heal to report[8].t. NOTE: I used slot letters, not ability names — see notes.

notes: TWO THINGS THE USER NEEDS TO DECIDE. (1) ABILITY NAMES. packet.enemyAbilities is NULL for Zaahen, so this run has no name authority for him. The only names anywhere in the brief are inside missingInteractions headlines: 'The Darkin Glaive (Q)', 'Aureate Rush (E)', 'Grim Deliverance (R)' — W and passive are unnamed even there. I deliberately did NOT ship those three names, because a single unconfirmed source is exactly how 'Ares of Blaze' and 'Noxious Blight' got onto pages, and a wrong name on a brand-new champion is the most visible error possible. Instead I wrote slot letters ('his Q', 'his R', 'his E') with the mechanics, all of which come from enemyKit text I can verify. If the user confirms those three names are correct, this matchup is worth a fast second pass to swap them in — it would upgrade every field I touched. (2) I did NOT write the missingInteractions headline 'Your Obliterate (Q) shuts off Zaahen's Aureate Rush (E)'. It comes from the same Mordekaiser Q grounding derived-flag that misfires across this entire slice; Riot's Obliterate text describes no grounding. Same call as the Warwick matchup. Separately: the level chart here is the one place in this slice where I could not simply follow the packet, because the packet's own defects list says its chart is wrong. My replacement keeps the packet's rows 0-4 and moves only the two item rows — flagged Medium confidence for that reason.
